```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(anndata)
```
```{r}
skin_so = readRDS("Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/healthyskin.rds")
sampled_cells = sample(x = colnames(skin_so), size = 6000, replace = F)
skin_mat = skin_so@assays$RNA@counts[,sampled_cells]
sampled_mat = skin_so@meta.data[colnames(skin_mat),]
colnames(skin_mat) = sampled_mat$cell_type
skin_mat = as.matrix((skin_mat))
write.table(skin_mat,"Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/healthyskin.txt",sep = '\t',quote = F)

```
```{r}
AD.tpm <- read.delim(file="Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/RNA-seQC/RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-AD-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.gene_tpm.gct.gz", skip=2)

AE.tpm <- read.delim(file="Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/RNA-seQC/RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-AE-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.gene_tpm.gct.gz", skip=2)

UE.tpm <- read.delim(file="Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/RNA-seQC/RP-2197_DFCI-BLSKOGVH-01-UE-01_v3_RNA_OnPrem.gene_tpm.gct.gz", skip=2)

rownames(UE.tpm)  = UE.tpm$Name
aload1$UE.tpm = UE.tpm[aload1$NA.,'RP.2197_DFCI.BLSKOGVH.01.UE.01_v3_RNA_OnPrem']
rownames(AD.tpm)  = AD.tpm$Name
aload1$AD.tpm = AD.tpm[aload1$NA.,'RP.2197_DFCI.BLSKOGVH.01.AD.01_v3_RNA_OnPrem']
rownames(AE.tpm)  = AE.tpm$Name
aload1$AE.tpm = AE.tpm[aload1$NA.,'RP.2197_DFCI.BLSKOGVH.01.AE.01_v3_RNA_OnPrem']

mixture = merge(UE.tpm[,c('Description','RP.2197_DFCI.BLSKOGVH.01.UE.01_v3_RNA_OnPrem')],
                AE.tpm[,c('Description','RP.2197_DFCI.BLSKOGVH.01.AE.01_v3_RNA_OnPrem')])


mixture = merge(mixture,
                AD.tpm[,c('Description','RP.2197_DFCI.BLSKOGVH.01.AD.01_v3_RNA_OnPrem')])

colnames(mixture) = c("Gene","UE","AE","AD")

mixture = distinct(mixture)
mixture = mixture %>% group_by(Gene) %>% slice(1)
write.table(mixture,"Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/mixture.tsv",sep = '\t',quote = F,row.names = F)

```

#https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/collections/73f82ac8-15cc-4fcd-87f8-5683723fce7f S2
skin_so = readRDS("/Users/yiren/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/Nico_Yiren/Data/Zebra patient/Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/healthyskin2.rds")

sampled_cells = sample(x = colnames(skin_so), size = 6000, replace = F)
skin_mat = skin_so@assays$RNA@counts[,sampled_cells]
sampled_mat = skin_so@meta.data[colnames(skin_mat),]
colnames(skin_mat) = sampled_mat$cell_type
skin_mat = as.matrix((skin_mat))
ensembl.genes <- rownames(skin_mat)
library('EnsDb.Hsapiens.v79')
geneIDs1 <- ensembldb::select(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v79, keys= ensembl.genes, keytype = "GENEID", columns = c("SYMBOL","GENEID"))
skin_mat = skin_mat[geneIDs1$GENEID,]
rownames(skin_mat) = geneIDs1$SYMBOL
write.table(skin_mat,"Bulk RNA/BLSKOGVH01/healthyskin2.txt",sep = '\t',quote = F)
dim(skin_so)
